step_definition: capsule clearance >=2mm and contact-off >=60ms then landing, foot travel >=5mm; first 0.5s excluded
step_definition_zh: 足底离地至少2mm并持续60ms，重新着地时足中心移动至少5mm；最初0.5秒不计。
domain: flat floor, nominal friction 1, deterministic policy, 0.015rad initial joint perturbation; simulation only

swing_peak_diagnostics.definition: Actual capsule-bottom peak within each complete planned swing after startup; no 60ms duration condition in this peak metric; no-lift swings are counted.

priority_diagnostics.body_contact_scope: Knee motor meshes are on hip_pitch rigid bodies; elbow meshes are on shoulder_pitch bodies. Net force may include self-contact; not a direct kneeling classifier.
priority_diagnostics.range_scope: Per-environment p95-p05 over actual joint samples, then median across environments.

knee_contact_rule.method: Existing knee motor collision primitives vs plane z=0, checked each 20ms control step; cylinder support bound conservative for tessellation

leg_propulsion_diagnostics.definition: P_i = F_on_foot_world_xy dot ROOT_velocity_world_xy; positive along actual body velocity, negative opposed. This is a body-propulsion proxy, not exact friction/contact-point work or motor work.
leg_propulsion_diagnostics.sampling: 40 physical steps at0.5ms per20ms control step; foot-only solver force sensors in world frame, forward dynamics excluded; positive/negative split before averaging; first1s excluded
leg_propulsion_diagnostics.contact_gate: upward force>1N and actual capsule bottom<=1mm
